description:
Search for active cars in the UK market.

This tool searches for currently active car listings in the UK using the Marketcheck API.
It supports comprehensive filtering by location, vehicle specifications, price, and more.
Includes all parameters supported by the /search/car/uk/active endpoint.

DO NOT USE CARFAX FIELDS: Carfax data on this server is incomplete and unreliable. Do
NOT pass `carfax_1_owner` or `carfax_clean_title` (via kwargs or otherwise) as filters,
do NOT request them in facets/stats, and do NOT infer ownership history, title status,
or any other meaning from any `carfax_*` value that might appear in a listing. Treat
all Carfax fields as if they did not exist.

IMPORTANT: Before filtering by specific field values (make, model, trim, body_type, fuel_type, etc.),
use the 'facets' parameter to discover available values in the API. Field values may be
represented differently than expected. For example:
- Use facets="make,model,trim,body_type" to see all available options
- This prevents filtering errors due to incorrect field value assumptions
- Facets show actual data distribution and available filter options

STALENESS METRICS — dos_active vs dom_active (read before answering "how long has
this car been for sale" questions):
  - dos_active (Days on Site): days this listing has been active at the CURRENT
    dealer. Answers "how long has THIS DEALER been trying to sell this car."
    DEFAULT: use dos_active for stale-inventory and "how long has it been listed"
    questions.
  - dom_active (Days on Market): cumulative days the VEHICLE has been actively
    listed for sale across ALL dealers — it survives dealer-to-dealer transfers.
    Use ONLY when the question is about the vehicle's total market exposure, e.g.
    evaluating a car at auction or in a dealer trade: a car showing dos_active=15
    at the current store may show dom_active=60 because it has been passed around
    dealers for two months.
This rule applies to choosing filter params (dos_active_range vs dom_active_range),
sort_by values, and which field to read and report from listing results. When
unsure which the user means, default to dos_active.

base_ext_color.description: Base exterior color to match (alias for base_exterior_color).

base_exterior_color.description: Base exterior color to match (comma-separated values).

base_int_color.description: Base interior color to match (alias for base_interior_color).

base_interior_color.description: Base interior color to match (comma-separated values).

body_type.description: To filter listing on their body type (comma-separated values).

car_type.description: Car type. Allowed values are - new / used.

city.description: To filter listing on City in which they are listed.

combined_mpg_range.description: Combined mileage range for UK (min-max format).

country.description: To filter listing on Country (uk, england, scotland, northern ireland, wales).

county.description: To filter listing on county in which they are listed.

cylinders.description: To filter listing on their cylinders (comma-separated values).

dealer_id.description: Dealer id to filter the listings.

dealer_type.description: Filter based on dealer type (franchise or independent).

dedup.description: If true, will give results with is_searchable irrespective of dealer.

dom_180_range.description: Last 180 Days on Market range to filter cars.

dom_active_range.description: Cumulative days the VEHICLE has been actively listed across ALL dealers (survives dealer transfers), format min-max. Use for total-market-exposure analysis; otherwise prefer dos_active_range. See STALENESS METRICS above.

dom_range.description: Days on Market range to filter cars (format: min-max e.g. 10-50).

doors.description: Doors to filter the cars on (comma-separated integer values).

dos_active_range.description: Days the listing has been active at the CURRENT dealer, format min-max. Dealer-level staleness — DEFAULT metric for "how long has it been for sale" questions. See STALENESS METRICS above.

drivetrain.description: To filter listing on their drivetrain (comma-separated values).

engine.description: To filter listing on their engine (comma-separated values).

engine_size.description: Engine Size to match (comma-separated values from facets API).

exclude_dealer_ids.description: A list of dealer ids to exclude from result.

exclude_make.description: Make values to exclude from results.

exclude_mc_website_ids.description: A list of MC website ids to exclude from result.

exclude_sources.description: A list of sources to exclude from result.

exterior_color.description: Exterior color to match (comma-separated values from facets API).

facet_sort.description:
Controls sort order of facet terms:
- count (default): Sort by frequency (highest first)
- index: Sort alphabetically

facets.description:
Field facets return unique terms and their counts for categorical data, useful for building search filters and understanding inventory distribution.
Syntax: facets=field_name|offset|limit|min_count
- offset (default: 0): Start position for terms
- limit (default: 20, max: 1000): Number of terms to return
- min_count (optional): Minimum count for a term to be included
Example: facets=make|0|60|2 returns top 60 makes with at least 2 listings each

fetch_all_photos.description: When False (default), limits photo links to single photo per listing to reduce token usage. When True, returns all photo links.

first_seen_at_mc_days.description: First seen at MC days range in format "max-min" (e.g., "15-5").

first_seen_at_mc_range.description: First seen at MC date range.

first_seen_at_source_days.description: First seen at source days range in format "max-min" (e.g., "15-5").

first_seen_at_source_range.description: First seen at source date range.

first_seen_days.description: First seen days range in format "max-min" (e.g., "30-10" for 10 to 30 days ago).

fuel_type.description: To filter listing on their fuel type (comma-separated values).

include_build_object.description:
When True, includes build object in response. Build object structure:
- year (number): Model year
- make (string): Vehicle manufacturer
- model (string, optional): Vehicle model
- model_variant (string, optional): Vehicle model variant
- trim (string, optional): Trim level
- variant (string, optional): Specific variant identifier
- body_type (string, optional): Body style (saloon, hatchback, estate, etc.)
- vehicle_type (string, optional): Vehicle category
- transmission (string, optional): Transmission type
- drivetrain (string, optional): Drivetrain configuration
- fuel_type (string, optional): Fuel type (petrol, diesel, electric, hybrid, etc.)
- engine (string, optional): Engine description
- engine_size (number, optional): Engine displacement
- doors (number, optional): Number of doors
- cylinders (number, optional): Number of cylinders
- made_in (string, optional): Manufacturing country
- overall_height, overall_length, overall_width (string, optional): Vehicle dimensions
- wheelbase_category (string, optional): Wheelbase classification
- std_seating (string, optional): Standard seating capacity
- highway_mpg (number, optional): Highway fuel economy
- city_mpg (number, optional): City fuel economy
- combined_mpg (number, optional): Combined fuel economy
- seating_capacity (number, optional): Passenger seating capacity
- performance_torque_ftlb (number, optional): Torque in foot-pounds
- performance_maxspeed_mph (number, optional): Maximum speed in miles per hour
- performance_torque_rpm (number, optional): Torque at RPM
- performance_power_bhp (number, optional): Power in brake horsepower
- performance_power_rpm (number, optional): Power at RPM
- performance_torque_nm (number, optional): Torque in Newton-meters
- performance_power_kw (number, optional): Power in kilowatts
- performance_co2 (number, optional): CO2 emissions rating
- euro_status (number, optional): Euro emissions standard status

include_dealer_object.description:
When True, includes dealer object in response. Dealer object structure:
- id (number): Unique dealer identifier
- website (string): Dealer website URL
- name (string): Dealer business name
- dealer_type (string, optional): Dealer classification (franchise, independent)
- street, city, county, country (string, optional): Address components
- latitude, longitude (string, optional): Geographic coordinates
- postal_code (string, optional): UK postal code
- phone (string, optional): Contact phone number
- seller_email (string, optional): Contact email address
- fca_status (string, optional): FCA authorization status
- preferred_dealer (boolean, optional): Flag indicating if this is a preferred dealer

include_mc_dealership_object.description:
When True, includes mc_dealership object in response. McDealership object structure:
- mc_website_id (number, optional): MarketCheck website identifier
- mc_dealer_id (number, optional): MarketCheck dealer identifier
- mc_location_id (number, optional): MarketCheck location identifier
- mc_rooftop_id (number, optional): MarketCheck rooftop identifier
- mc_dealership_group_id (number, optional): MarketCheck dealership group identifier
- mc_dealership_group_name (string, optional): MarketCheck dealership group name
- mc_sub_dealership_group_id (number, optional): MarketCheck sub-dealership group identifier
- mc_sub_dealership_group_name (string, optional): MarketCheck sub-dealership group name
- mc_category (string, optional): MarketCheck seller category. UK market only supports: dealer
- website (string, optional): Dealer website URL
- name (string, optional): Dealer business name
- dealer_type (string, optional): Dealer classification (franchise, independent)
- street, city, county, country (string, optional): Address components
- latitude, longitude (string, optional): Geographic coordinates
- postal_code (string, optional): UK postal code
- phone (string, optional): Contact phone number
- fca_status (string, optional): FCA authorization status

include_non_vin_listings.description: To include non vin listings. Default is false.

insurance_group.description: Insurance group filter for UK vehicles.

interior_color.description: Interior color to match (comma-separated values from facets API).

inventory_count_range.description: Inventory count range to filter listings (min-max format).

last_seen_days.description: Last seen days range in format "max-min" (e.g., "3-1" for 1 to 3 days ago).

make.description: To filter listings on their make (comma-separated values).

match.description: Comma separated list of fields for exact match.

mc_category.description: Filter based on mc_category (Dealer, Dealership Group, etc.).

mc_dealer_id.description: To filter listings on their mc_dealer_id.

mc_dealership_group_id.description: To filter listings on their mc_dealership_group_id.

mc_dealership_group_name.description: To filter listings on their mc_dealership_group_name.

mc_location_id.description: To filter listings on their mc_location_id.

mc_rooftop_id.description: To filter listings on their mc_rooftop_id.

mc_sub_dealership_group_id.description: To filter listings on their mc_sub_dealership_group_id.

mc_sub_dealership_group_name.description: To filter listings on their mc_sub_dealership_group_name.

mc_website_id.description: Website id to filter the listings.

miles_range.description: Miles range to filter listings (format: min-max e.g. 1000-5000).

min_photo_links.description: Minimum number of photo links required.

min_photo_links_cached.description: Minimum number of cached photo links required.

model.description: To filter listings on their model (comma-separated values).

msrp_range.description: MSRP range to filter listings (format: min-max e.g. 1000-5000).

nodedup.description: If true, API will give results without is_searchable.

owned.description: When used with dealer_id, returns listings owned by dealer.

photo_links.description: Boolean to include only listings that have photo_links.

photo_links_cached.description: Boolean to include only listings with cached photo_links.

plot.description: If true, results in around 25k coordinates with limited fields to plot.

postal_code.description: To filter listing on postal code around which they are listed.

preferred_dealers_only.description: Filter to show only preferred dealers.

price_change_range.description: Price change range to filter listings.

price_range.description: Price range to filter listings (format: min-max e.g. 1000-5000).

radius.description: Radius around the search location in miles (max: 7000).

range_facets.description: Comma separated list of numeric fields for range facets.

rows.description: Number of results to return. Default is 10. Max is 50.

seating_capacity.description: To filter on vehicle seating capacity.

sort_by.description: Sort by field. Default sort field is distance from the given point. For staleness sorting, default to dos_active (current dealer) over dom_active (all dealers) — see STALENESS METRICS above.

sort_order.description: Sort order - asc or desc. Default sort order is asc.

source.description: To filter listing on their source (comma-separated URLs).

start.description: Page number to fetch results. Default is 0. Max pagination: 10000.

state.description: To filter listing on State in which they are listed.

stats.description: List of fields for which stats need to be generated.

stock_no.description: To filter listing on their stock number on lot.

transmission.description: To filter listing on their transmission (comma-separated values).

trim.description: To filter listing on their trim (comma-separated values).

variant.description: To filter listing on their variant (comma-separated values).

vehicle_type.description: To filter listing on their vehicle type.

wheelbase_category.description: To filter listing on their wheelbase category.

year.description: To filter listing on their year (comma-separated values).

year_range.description: Year range to filter listings (format: min-max e.g. 2019-2021).

ymmt.description: Comma separated list of Year, Make, Model, Trim combinations.

zip.description: To filter listing on ZIP around which they are listed.
